answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a scarce, non-transferable issuance-slot bond before it may transact. Slots are numbered claims drawn from a hard cap. Peers verify them at a public audit summit by recomputing each merkle inclusion proof and confirming the serial is bound to only one key. Anyone who would wander the market with sockpuppets must buy and lock a fresh slot for every fake ID, so attacker cost scales linearly. The fable that clones are free does not survive that cap and check.
